newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico phone firm Ameritel investment outlined.
newsitem.headline: Mexico phone firm Ameritel investment outlined.

text.p: Grupo Radio Centro said on Tuesday the telecommunications firm Ameritel would invest $4.4 million of its own capital next year and seek an additional $31 million from third-party investors.
Ameritel is a joint venture formed in April between Radio Centro and U.S. telecommunications firm that Radio Centro would not identify.

It is awaiting government permission to join a host of other firms that will compete with former monopoly Telmex for domestic long-distance clients starting in 1997. Competition for corporate clients began in August.

"The company (Ameritel) is committed to investing approximately $4.4 million, which includes compensations and reimbursements to its Mexican partners in the telecommunications sectors," Radio Centro said in an annual report to investors.
